prerequisites.reason: Using external libraries requires basic Python syntax and import/use of code.
Managing packages requires understanding the Python environment where packages are installed.
Manipulating data in Python requires core syntax, variables, and data structures.
Practical Python data manipulation commonly depends on external libraries such as pandas or NumPy.
Defining and using functions requires understanding basic Python syntax and execution.
Debugging Python code requires understanding the basic code being inspected.
Advanced Python features build on core language syntax and concepts.
Many advanced Python topics rely on functions, such as decorators, closures, and higher-order functions.
